QUOTE: The library's own `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc` uses the same runtime hook to replace the allocator with a static heap. ... `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) takes a caller-supplied buffer and calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed`/`buffer_alloc_free_mutexed`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function, but never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter.
